messages.content: The organizer moved Friday's first Cambridge appointment to the Back Bay workshop venue and added a 7:30 a.m. breakfast there. Please update the itinerary without changing the hotel or the flights we selected.

The 2:00 p.m. Cambridge appointment and 7:30 p.m. publisher dinner in Back Bay remain unchanged. The hotel still fits the schedule, and there is no reason to replace either selected flight.
How much travel time should I record for getting to the remaining Cambridge meeting?

Allow 35 to 45 minutes by taxi or rideshare from Back Bay to Cambridge in ordinary midday traffic, and leave about 60 minutes before the 2:00 p.m. meeting to cover traffic and the walk into the building. Public transit is more likely to take 40 to 55 minutes depending on the exact address and transfers.
Put in a 1:00 p.m. departure for now. Also, does the new breakfast create any problem with Saturday's airport timing?

No. The breakfast and Friday appointments do not affect Saturday's plan. The selected Saturday flight still departs Boston at 9:10 a.m., so the requested 6:30 a.m. sedan remains appropriate. The only concern would be a new Saturday morning commitment, which has not been added.
Good. I also need an itemized hotel receipt that shows the room charge separately from the destination charge. Can the hotel do that?

Yes. The hotel can issue an itemized folio with nightly room charges, taxes, and each destination charge shown as separate line items. I have recorded that the folio should be requested at checkout and emailed as a PDF for reimbursement.
Then leave every reservation as it is and give me the revised outline.

Saturday, check out in time for the requested 6:30 a.m. sedan and the selected 9:10 a.m. nonstop to Denver. Request the itemized PDF folio at checkout.
